text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone on the investigation team was 
working so enthusiastically. 
Yet I... simply scolded them 
unilaterally.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The expressions they had yesterday... 
It's clear that I dealt them a heavy 
shock.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(First, I must give them a proper apology. 
And then change how I interact with them. 
I need to be the one to meet them 
halfway.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Everyone, I am deeply sorry for yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The way I spoke sounded as though I was 
completely rejecting your efforts... 
I am reflecting on this with all my heart!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I want to proceed in a way 
that feels comfortable for all of you! 
Would you please teach me your ways?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
S-Senpai?! We were out of line too, so... 
Um............ w-what should we—

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, our ways, huh~~~... 
Then today, let's all play together with 
Fenomeno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's play "VR Brawl Party"! I've been 
really into it lately! 
Windy-senpai, Urara-senpai, you've played 
it before, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see. I don't have any experience with 
this, but I'll do my best not to hold 
everyone back, sir!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Gocha Battle is an online 5v5 fighting 
game. It's a team game, so don't worry 
even if it's your first time!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If you reduce all opponents' HP to zero, 
you win! Simple, right? ...Everyone ready? 
Let's begin!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is this my weap—wait, I thought I 
selected a nightstick!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, eyes forward! The enemy's rushing in! 
Prepare to intercept!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! Tooh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pegasus Mach Strike!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a special move! Biko-chan, that was 
so cool!! That finishing pose at the end? 
You looked just like Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! Heheh, I practiced 
Carrotman's victory pose a ton!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's even a special cutscene where 
the outfit changes! I'll also—whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...I-I was eliminated right away... Urgh! 
And after I wanted to be of help to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Phenomeno-senpai—whoops! Shoot, taking on 
two at once might be tough...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There are two over here, too...! They're 
good! They're trying to keep Biko and 
Windy-chan from attacking!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... At this rate, we'll get whittled 
down and lose...!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there just a bit longer! You've 
barely taken any damage! You're blocking 
like crazy! You're wearing them out!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am...! Windy-chan isn't gonna 
just take a beating lying down!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Biko-chan, I'm coming to help! Teiyaaah! 
Hawawa~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Now's the time! Taaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Nice follow-up, Urara-chan! You win the 
'Ultimate Team Player Award'! Our teamwork 
is amazing! Let's keep up the synergy and 
push forward!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Ooh...! Despite being at a disadvantage, 
no one's morale has dropped! In fact, it 
might even be rising—!)

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan, dodging that attack was 
amazing! Look, your moves have them 
completely confused!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku, just as planned! Time for another 
bite of Windy-chan's fangs!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: CHOMMMMP!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Windy-san, great move! Big-san's callout 
just now was spot-on, too!)

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
It hit!! Way to go, Windy-chan! Big-san 
won't be outdone either!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, me neither! I've still got plenty 
in the tank! Teyaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Biko-san's morale is rising even more...! 
I see, it's because Big-san keeps cheering 
everyone on!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(And she isn't just cheering mindlessly. 
Big-san is genuinely admiring everyone's 
strengths and telling them so...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Because she truly acknowledges them, her 
words resonate. Praise is awakening their 
drive—!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, I see. The exact opposite of what 
I did yesterday... Acknowledging them, and 
telling them they're wonderful. That is 
what's truly important...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san, excellent diversion! You 
created an opening! Urara-san, your 
unpredictable movements are working! Let's 
go wild!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...! Alright, I'm going all out!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san, your stability! Your attack 
power! They're truly extraordinary! Our 
team's victory is all thanks to your fists 
of justice!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* ...Heheh, that's 'cause—I'm a 
hero!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* ...Just a little more...! 
This is where you hold your ground, 
Big-san...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Your tenacity goes far beyond this, 
doesn't it, Big-san?! Never giving up! On 
that point alone, you lose to no one!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even when cornered, you never gave up on 
victory! Because you kept inspiring 
everyone, we've finally made it this far!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Victory is right before your eyes! Finish 
it, Big-san!!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! I won't let this big 
opportunity slip away!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Big Super Big Bang!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It landed...! The one shining brightest at 
the very end is you, Big-san!!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I made a pretty big splash, didn't 
I?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That game was so fun! We even beat some 
tough opponents! Big-senpai's ultimate 
move at the end was super cool!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it was all thanks to everyone's 
cheering! I got super fired up! Especially 
you, Phenomeno-chan! That was some 
passionate cheering!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Because your performances were truly 
magnificent. Biko-san leading everyone 
like a true hero, Urara-san giving it her 
pure, earnest best—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san using her wits to spearhead the 
frontline, and Big-san praising and 
inspiring everyone. Every single one of 
your unique traits shone brightly.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Every one of you is a wonderful Umamusume 
endowed with peerless strengths. When I 
scouted you, and even now... I have never 
ceased to believe that!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Which is why... please allow me to ask you 
once more.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I promise to do everything I can to make 
things comfortable for you! Please, lend 
me your strength for my investigation, 
sir!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...So that's how you felt about us... We'd 
never abandon your investigation!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Guess it can't be helped! The 
super-talented 
Windy-chan and company will just have to 
support our useless captain!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Everyone, please support your 
inadequate captain. 
I look forward to working with you again 
starting tomorrow, ma'am!
